variants.label: PV3900 common MUST map with optional BMS block

notes: Keeps the common MUST PV/PH18 profile, register map and telemetry conventions; only the optional BMS block (109-113) is added.
Controls inherit the document-backed MUST surface, all untested, available only in Full Control. The reporting unit runs in Read only mode.

known_limitations: SOC and separate BMS voltage/current/temperature require a BMS connected to the inverter (CAN or RS485). Missing or invalid data stays unavailable; BMS current keeps the native signed convention.
Register 114 returned the BMS SOH (100%) on the reporting unit but is not exposed until confirmed on more units.
Previously accumulated energy/history is not rewritten.
knowledge_summary: PV3900 (retail PV39-8048 TLV) is identified by the PV3900 marker at 20000-20001 and keeps the common MUST map. A field capture with a CAN-connected PACE BMS confirmed the optional 109-113 BMS block already used for PV3300 (voltage/10, signed current/10, temperature, SOC) against the BMS app and SmartValue.
